name: governor-subgraph
description: Subgraph for the Olympus Governor contracts

scripts.deploy: GRAPH_VERSION_LABEL=$(cat .subgraph-version) && source .env && graph deploy --node https://api.studio.thegraph.com/deploy/ --deploy-key $GRAPH_DEPLOY_KEY --version-label $GRAPH_VERSION_LABEL olympus-governor
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const agent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!agent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('This project requires pnpm.'); process.exit(1); }"
